business_summary: Hymson Laser Technology Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells lasers and automation equipment in China and internationally. The company offers coating and calendaring and slitting, high-speed laser notching intelligent, high speed laser ablation, and high speed winding machine, as well as intelligent solutions for assembly line, solutions for the top-cover assembly of the battery, auto battery baking solutions, and EV battery module/pack for EV battery applications; 3C battery, transformer, VCM, electronic atomization, PCB/SMT, precision structural parts, brittle material, dispensing, and new display machines for consumer electronic applications. It also provides photovoltaic machines for cell, PV cell module, PV glass, battery energy storge, inverter, and solar mounting machines; kitchen and bathroom processing equipment, fitness equipment, home display, household energy storage and small power battery solutions, and intelligent household chain products for smart home applications; medical equipment; and BAPV, BIPV, elevator, modern business display technology, security monitoring, and UPS. In addition, the company offers body sheet metal processing, automobile electronic module, and automotive display module solutions for transportation applications; and sheet metal laser cutting, tube laser cutting, 3D five-axis cutting, automatic production line, and laser welding solutions for sheet-metal working applications. Hymson Laser Technology Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
